paragraph: A captain scanning the surface of Boston Bay, off the coast of South Australia, spotted something that should not have been there. It was a young kangaroo, more than one and a half miles from any shore. The animal held still as a scuba diver and his crew drew near, as if it knew this was its only chance. They lifted it aboard and carried it back to dry land. The kangaroo rested. The crew returned to the water. That was enough.

seed.summary: In a story too ‘Australiana’ to believe, a scuba diver and his crew rescued a kangaroo over one and a half miles out to sea.
